{{Quote|Wow, Booles Roor has already made it to the Royal Park. He does not disappoint!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]|<ref name="Kinect Star Wars">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>}}
The '''Royal Park''' was an open, wide park in [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] capital [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Several buildings were located in it.

The [[Unidentified Bespin Podracing course|Bespin podracing course]] cut through this location, which led to the [[Cloud City Core]].
